Quote: Decide what matters before distractions decide for you. Clear priorities make it easier to choose well when the day gets noisy.
SupportingText: Clear priorities make everyday choices easier to guide.
InspiredBy: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective Teens
Author: Sean Covey

Quote: Not being able to do something today does not mean you can never learn it. Add “yet” and keep the door open.
SupportingText: Yet keeps the door open for effort and learning.
Author: Carol S. Dweck

Quote: Choose kindness before you know someone’s whole story. People can be carrying pain you cannot see.
SupportingText: Kindness sees the person before judging the situation.
Author: R. J. Palacio

Quote: Talent is not enough when the excitement disappears. Growth comes from continuing to put in effort even on the days that are not fun.
SupportingText: Effort matters most when excitement has already faded.
Author: Angela Duckworth

Quote: Your attention belongs to you. Do not give every quiet moment to a screen; choose when technology deserves your time.
SupportingText: Protecting attention helps you choose how technology serves you.
Author: Cal Newport

Quote: Asking for help is not weakness. Sometimes the bravest way forward is admitting that you do not have to do everything alone.
SupportingText: Bravery can look like admitting you need support.
InspiredBy: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse
Author: Charlie Mackesy

Quote: Do not reject an idea just because it feels strange or scary. Give curiosity a chance before fear decides what is possible.
SupportingText: Curiosity gives new ideas room to become something real.
InspiredBy: What Do You Do With an Idea?
Author: Kobi Yamada

Quote: You do not need a perfect beginning. Make one small start, then let that first step show you what can come next.
SupportingText: Starting imperfectly is still a powerful way to begin.
Author: Peter H. Reynolds

Quote: Learning differently does not mean you are less intelligent. Sometimes you simply need a different path to reach the same understanding.
SupportingText: Different learning paths can still lead to real understanding.
Author: Lynda Mullaly Hunt

Quote: The most important things are not always the easiest to see. Care, attention, and love often reveal value that appearances miss.
SupportingText: Care reveals value that appearances often fail to show.
Author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
